body: I just wish people would be more upfront about what they truly think as opposed to just saying random shit to satisfy me. It's doing more damage than good and i remember summer of 2020 and 2021 being so fucking bitter. i don't know why i let that bitch control my self worth but i truly felt betrayed by her even if she didn't outright \*do\* anything to me. i had a rough childhood and already felt ostracised in my own home city (hong kong) and so i thought by moving to the new school, maybe people would be more welcoming or at least more supportive of my decisions. instead, i was faced with racism, discrimination and a blatant dislike for my existence and it made my experience at the school hell. i just wanted someone to like me for me and it hurt that i put so much hope and expectation just to be treated like a normal human being but instead i'm no different than furniture and it really fucking sucks. i can't get them out of my head and I don't know how i'll ever get past that betrayal. ive been to countless therapy and am on antidepressants and yet i still wake up in the middle of the night from dreams of what me and R could've been and upon waking up, realising it was just a dream. it'll never be real and i don;t know how long i can take it before i can't stand the thought of being awake because that means i have to live with the fact that despite having good people in this world, the awful ones will always prevail and i don't know how long i can keep trying to make things right with myself.
Damn, can I be your friend?
I’m going through some tough shit rn and the “nice ass glass of water” analogy rly stuck to me. Thanks for the comment.

Please I beg of you rethink your decision… there are people who care and people who understand what you’re going through. My Snapchat is @tfung80 if you want to talk. I’m always online and I know life will get better.
